active_lavender_rule: identity_confirmed_active_lavender = temporal_active_lavender * lavender_given_odor when odor_presence >= 0.5; otherwise 0
fading_rule: retain temporal lavender-recovery evidence without the presence gate because a fading state may continue below current odor presence
selection_basis: Stationary complete-trial grouped validation only; raster geometry and scores were not used for tuning.
